decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX is a publicly rebranded, further-developed evolution of the established BASIC 518 trommel, so prior investment and announced positioning favor continuing it.

The AK series was upgraded to EU Stage V engines and presented at a trade fair, a visible recent investment that management will want to justify, and it sits at the core of the firm's mobile shredding business.
The mobile high-speed grinder line moved from a mention to its own page in 2019, and it fits the firm's mobile processing direction, so persistence is likely despite little evidence of results.
Management publicly claimed the new CERON generation sets standards and cites it in plant installations, which makes it a committed flagship for the stationary segment.
